name: a-run-going-in-circles-stops
description: SPEC.md 4.10 and 3.6 (v1.14): a run that keeps asking for an act the ledger has already answered is stopped by the repetition bound between turns, with status Failed and the failure code going_in_circles. The bound counts replays only: the act ran once, and every ask after it was a replay. Watched live, twice: a model asked for the same thing eleven more times with the note in front of it, and a turn cap of sixty-four is sixty turns of the same question.
